<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the upfield signals that correspond to typical methyl carbon chemical shifts are at 52.24 ppm (likely an O‑CH₃), 43.47 ppm (likely an N‑CH₃), and 38.60 ppm (likely a carbonyl‑adjacent CH₃). No other methyl‑type signals are present. Therefore the molecule contains three CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
